JobDescription: Find the latest job opportunities in Rwanda and beyond. We publish daily updates on government jobs, private sector openings, internships, and scholarships. Stay informed and never miss a chance to grow your career.
trafficDescription: We provide comprehensive lessons on traffic laws and road safety. Learn the rules of the road, understand traffic signs, and gain the knowledge you need to drive responsibly and legally.
testDescription: Track all provisional test events happening today—quick, clear, and reliable updates,Never miss a driving test update
aboutLine1: From job updates to driving test preparation, Tubyikorere is your trusted platform for navigating essential services in Rwanda. Learn, grow, and take control — anytime, anywhere.
visionDescription: We envision a self-reliant and digitally empowered Rwanda, where every individual can independently access, understand, and utilize essential services — from job opportunities to public procedures — with ease, confidence, and clarity.
missionLine1: Making tech education accessible, engaging, and rewarding for everyone,
missionLine2: We aim to bridge the skills gap through a hands-on learning platform.
